title: Signal Lens
tagline: See everything that matters, nothing that doesn't.
description: Every portfolio company drowns in noise. The Signal Lens cuts through — AI-ranked priority surfaces the 3–5 signals that actually matter right now. Not dashboards of metrics. Curated signals with the context needed to act.

title: Impact Lens
tagline: Every technical event has a dollar sign.
description: Technology exists to serve business outcomes. The Impact Lens translates every operational event into financial consequence — a vessel delay becomes fuel cost, a security incident becomes a compliance fine exposure, a missed campaign launch becomes lost brand value.

title: Anticipation Lens
description: The best incident is the one that never happens. The Anticipation Lens projects the current state forward — predicting failures, forecasting outcomes, and surfacing risks before they materialize. Vessel arrival predictions. Attack trajectory modeling. Market trend forecasting.

title: Topology Lens
description: No entity operates in isolation. The Topology Lens reveals the relationship graph — fleet vessel networks, attack surface dependencies, property-market connections, creative asset hierarchies. When one node changes, the ripple is visible.

title: Posture Lens
description: Complexity collapses into one number. The Posture Lens synthesizes every signal, metric, and risk factor into a single real-time score — front and center, always visible. Fleet Readiness. Security Posture. Portfolio Health. One authoritative score per domain.

title: Velocity Lens
tagline: How fast are we getting better?
description: Speed without stability is chaos. Stability without speed is stagnation. The Velocity Lens tracks the rate of improvement — DORA metrics for engineering, throughput for research, deal pipeline velocity for real estate, content production rate for creative.
